'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[coordinate clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]]. In case the player has started but not yet completed the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest, they may require the [[royal seal]] to access the shipyard, which can be retrieved from [[King Narnode Shareen]] in the Grand Tree.
